title: Member Handbook — Booking a RideLink Trip
content:
These are the conditions under which a trip is booked on a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation benefit, on every RideLink level of service. The figures each condition refers to — channels, notice, hours and minutes — are the level's own booking and trip timing terms.

## Conditions of booking

1. **Purpose.** A trip is booked for a covered medical, dental, behavioral health or pharmacy appointment with an enrolled Medicaid provider, or for a value-added purpose.
2. **Channel and horizon.** It is booked through one of the level's booking channels, no more than the number of calendar days ahead of the appointment date that the level allows at most.
3. **Active benefit.** Trips are booked only on a benefit in active status. The status is read from the benefit record before the trip is booked; a benefit in pending assessment, suspended or closed status is not active.
4. **Routine notice.** A routine trip is booked only when the appointment date the member gives is at least the level's routine notice in business days after the booking date. Business days exclude Saturdays, Sundays and state holidays, and the booking date itself is not counted. The appointment date for this test is the date the member states for the trip being booked.
5. **Urgent and discharge trips.** Where the level allows urgent same-day trips, an urgent trip confirmed by the treating provider and a hospital discharge trip are booked without advance notice and picked up within the level's urgent pickup hours or hospital discharge pickup hours respectively.
6. **Running the trip.** Trips run within the level's trip service hours; they may be shared where the level allows shared rides, with the member on board no longer than the level's most time on board; they drop the member no earlier than the level's earliest drop-off before the appointment; and they pick up a will-call return within the level's will-call return pickup time.

## Counting the routine notice — boundary cases

*Hypothetical weeks with no state holiday.*

| Booking date | Level's routine notice | Appointment date | Business days counted | Condition 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monday | 2 | Wednesday | Tuesday and Wednesday, 2 in all | Met |
| Monday | 2 | Tuesday | Tuesday only, 1 in all | Not met |
| Friday | 2 | Tuesday | Monday and Tuesday, 2 in all | Met |
| Friday | 2 | Monday | Monday only, 1 in all | Not met |
| Monday | 3 | Thursday | Tuesday to Thursday, 3 in all | Met |

Where a state holiday falls between the booking date and the appointment date, that day is not counted either.

## Points of judgement

- Condition 3 and condition 4 each stand on their own: an active benefit does not relieve a routine trip of its notice, and a timely request does not make a suspended benefit bookable.
